# OVYX Stage 3 — Platform Design System

**Status:** Shared design foundation implemented; component adoption is incremental.  
**Scope:** OVYX platform application, not websites generated by the Website Engine.  
**Frozen:** Existing OVYX logo/mark and the complete Web Studio experience.

## Design principles
- Luxury black-glass foundation with restrained gold as the signature accent.
- White for primary content; silver and muted gray for supporting information.
- Borders and surface contrast establish hierarchy before shadows or decoration.
- Consistent typography, spacing, radii, grid, focus, state and motion tokens.
- Full-width work surfaces by default; readable content measures for forms and prose.
- Components are namespaced and opt-in. No global button/input/table resets may unexpectedly restyle legacy areas.

## Shared token source
The file assets/css/ovyx-platform-design-system.css defines the canonical --ovyx-ds-* family: black/canvas/surface layers, gold/white/silver, semantic status and focus colours, UI/monospace font roles, type scale, spacing, responsive widths, grid, radii, borders, elevation and motion.

Existing prepaint theme variables remain intact. This layer does not override Firebase-synced appearance preferences or rewrite the dark/light theme runtime.

## Reusable components
All classes are opt-in under .ovyx-ds:
- Page shell, readable/wide page widths, page headers, eyebrow/title/description.
- Twelve-column responsive grid, stack and row primitives.
- Glass panels, panel headers/bodies, cards, dividers and metric labels.
- Primary, secondary, quiet and danger buttons.
- Labelled input, select, textarea, help and invalid states.
- Responsive overflow-safe tables.
- Semantic badges and icon containers.

Use semantic HTML and the existing icon library/assets. Do not replace the OVYX logo with a generic icon. Icon-only controls require accessible names.

## Interaction, accessibility and responsive standards
- Minimum 44px height for shared primary buttons and fields.
- Visible 2px focus ring with offset; focus never depends on hover.
- Reduced-motion media query removes non-essential transitions/animations.
- Grid collapses at 900px and 600px; tables scroll within their wrapper rather than causing page overflow.
- Status uses text and shape as well as colour.
- Inputs expose native labels and aria-invalid for validation; CSS does not invent validation or action logic.
- Component adoption must preserve owning page event handlers, state, data bindings and authorization.

## Integration and safety
Cloudflare Pages middleware injects the stylesheet into HTML responses. Static assets and API responses are untouched. The stylesheet only styles explicitly namespaced components, avoiding blanket resets. Web Studio has no .ovyx-ds adoption in this stage and its route, preview, editor, code workspace, menu and runtime remain unchanged.

Adoption is incremental: subsequent page work can migrate platform-owned surfaces page-by-page with visual and functional regression checks. Do not mass-replace legacy utility classes in one sweep.

## Verification
scripts/ovyx-platform-design-system.test.mjs checks required tokens, reusable components, responsive breakpoints, reduced-motion support, focus-visible treatment, opt-in scoping, shell injection and inclusion in the full test command.
